criteria.notes: Calendar and Feed remain clearly separated and composed around the current program.
No external visual reference was required; the maintained Foundry direction remains consistent.
Venue-specific editorial composition remains distinct from generic cards or dashboards.
Primary program titles, times, states, and support notes remain readable at both target sizes.
Light and dark scenarios preserve readable contrast and hierarchy.
Long program and announcement text stays bounded without clipping or overlap.
Full HD and compact layouts fill their assigned surfaces intentionally.
Media fallbacks, empty states, and both coordinated themes render cleanly.
The result retains a civic venue identity rather than copying another maintained example.
